Ambrosia Artemisiæfolia.



Ragweed. Roman Wormwood. Hogweed. (America.) N. O. Compositæ. Tincture of
        fresh flower heads and young shoots.



Clinical. ─   Coryza. Hay-fever.



Characteristics. ─   Dr. E. T. Marsh and another
        experimenter suffered severely from symptoms of coryza and hay-fever whilst observing the
        pollen of this plant. It should therefore be of service in similar affections.
